title: thladiantha henryi var. verrucosa
intro: Thladiantha henryi var. verrucosa, commonly known as the hairy warty thladiantha, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Cucurbitaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine and has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Thladiantha henryi var. verrucosa include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
